name: Small Wins
description: Eight light prompts for noticing the little things that went well. Read-only, no notes.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight light prompts for noticing small wins, shown on Reflection Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. This pack has no notes box, so it is just for thinking.
howToPlay: Read the prompt and let an answer come to mind.
Press Next for another prompt, or Back to return.
Stop whenever you like. Your place is saved.
tips: A small win can be as small as a tidy desk or a clear commit message.
